country_overview: The United States operates one of the most liberalised foreign-exchange regimes in the world. There are no general exchange controls or restrictions on current or capital account transactions for residents or non-residents. The US Dollar is the world's primary reserve currency.

summary.traveler: Travelers may bring in or take out unlimited amounts of US Dollars and foreign currency. No general currency declaration is required for normal travel amounts.
summary.business: Businesses and individuals enjoy full freedom to hold, transfer, convert and repatriate foreign currency through authorised banks and financial institutions.

rules.bring_foreign_currency_in: Unlimited amounts of US Dollars and foreign currency may be brought into the United States with no general declaration requirement for travelers.
rules.take_foreign_currency_out: Unlimited amounts of US Dollars and foreign currency may be taken out of the United States with no general restriction or declaration requirement for travelers.
rules.cash_declaration_threshold: No mandatory currency declaration threshold applies for ordinary travelers. Movements of USD 10,000 or more (or equivalent) in cash or bearer negotiable instruments must be reported to US Customs and Border Protection under anti-money laundering rules.
rules.resident_holding_rules: US residents may hold and maintain foreign currency accounts freely with authorised banks and financial institutions.
rules.non_resident_rules: Non-residents may open and operate foreign currency accounts and transfer funds freely without prior approval.
rules.business_invoicing_settlement: Business transactions may be invoiced and settled in foreign currency or USD. Cross-border payments and repatriation of funds are handled freely through authorised financial institutions.
rules.exchange_controls: The United States maintains no general exchange controls. The regime is fully liberalised for both current and capital account transactions.
rules.banking_conversion_practicality: Foreign exchange conversion and transfers are widely available through banks, licensed money exchange houses, and ATMs throughout the United States.
